sections.title: # Empowering Innovation, Excellence, And Future Leaders
sections.content: TKR College of Engineering and Technology – a modern temple of learning, an off shoot of the TKR Educational Society was established in the year 2002 in a sprawling, lush green 20 acre campus at Meerpet, Hyderabad. The college provides a serene and tranquil environment to the students, boosting their mental potential and preparing them in all aspects to face the cut- throat global competition with a smile on the face and emerge victorious.

content.title: # FOUNDER CHAIRMAN
content.content: The newsletter which is being rolled out today marks the launch of an effervescent activity that would enable the management to bring out to the eyes of the competitive world, the academic achievements of our prestigious institution.

content.title: # SECRETARY
content.content: Engineers play the most vital and important role in nation building. They create new inventions using best engineered technologies to make human life more comfortable, secure and productive.

content.title: # TREASURER
content.content: The motive of TKRES is to develop a global perspective to cope -up with the fast changing technology scenario.

content.title: # PRINCIPAL
content.content: Dr. D. V. Ravi Shankar, Principal, TKR College of Engineering & Technology had obtained his AMIE from Institution of Engineers in the year 1987.

sections.title: # Why Choose TKRCET?
sections.content: TKRCET stands out as a premier institution committed to academic excellence, innovation, and holistic development.

sections.title: # Accredited Excellence
sections.content: TKRCET is accredited with NAAC A+ and NBA, approved by AICTE, and recognized under UGC 2(f) & 12(B)—ensuring quality education and institutional credibility.

sections.title: # Strong Placement Record
sections.content: The college has a dedicated Training & Placement Cell focused on achieving 100% placement, with continuous student training and company tie-ups.

sections.title: # Modern Infrastructure
sections.content: The campus is equipped with state-of-the-art laboratories, smart classrooms, Wi-Fi-enabled learning spaces, and digital libraries to support advanced learning.

sections.title: # Research & Innovation
sections.content: Home to a 21,000 sq. ft. Research & Development center, the college fosters innovation through MSME incubation, startup support, and funded research projects.

sections.title: # Industry Connections
sections.content: TKRCET has established MoUs with ECIL and other industries, providing students with internship opportunities, industrial training, and real-world exposure.

sections.title: # Student-Centric Learning
sections.content: Offers add-on and bridge courses, mentorship programs, and personalized academic support—ensuring students thrive academically and professionally.

content.title: Dear all ECE students of 2024 batch who have applied for Alcognito placement drive are hereby informed that the online test which was scheduled on 22nd June 2024 could not be conducted due to technical issues at the hiring organization end, so it was informed by the hiring organization the same online test is being rescheduled to 29th June 2024 from 10:00 A.M. onwards.
